description: Verdict policy rules for deterministic verdict assignment. Applied after evidence collection.

verdict_types.CONTRADICTED: Claim is directly contradicted by authoritative evidence
verdict_types.NUANCED: Claim is substantially correct but missing critical qualifiers or context
verdict_types.OUTDATED: Claim was once correct but has been superseded by newer versions/data
verdict_types.UNVERIFIABLE: Insufficient evidence available to confirm or refute the claim
verdict_types.SUPPORTED: Claim is corroborated by at least one independent authoritative source
verdict_types.REFUSED: Claim is non-verifiable by nature (opinion, value judgment)

T2.label: Corroborated Secondary
sources: Established tech blog referencing T1 data
T2.downgrade_rule: If numerical values differ from T1 source → downgrade to NUANCED

T4.label: Unverifiable
sources: Internal company reports not publicly accessible
Offline community sharing with no record

authority_claims.description: P0 claims verified by rule engine (scripts)
authority_claims.fallback_policy: Retry 2x with exponential backoff (1s, 3s) → if still failing, mark UNVERIFIABLE

relationship_claims.description: Claims verified by anysearch + LLM cross-validation

rules.condition: Only T2 sources, values align with T1
Only T2 sources, values deviate from T1

rules.override: If severity is high, downgrade to UNVERIFIABLE

rules.condition: Evidence is > 6 months old from checked_at
rules.note: Current verdict maintained but staleness_warning set; severity adjusted

judgment_value_claims.description: Pure first-person value judgments — inherently non-verifiable
judgment_value_claims.note: These claims are rejected by design — no evidence search is performed

judgment_attribution_claims.description: Community consensus/attribution claims — verifiable that someone said it
judgment_attribution_claims.note: Verifies the attribution exists, not that the underlying claim is true. Max verdict: NUANCED

checkpoint_threshold.force_if: any verdict in [CONTRADICTED, NUANCED, UNVERIFIABLE] OR severity == high
